olivia_sales: Heads-up — BigBank wants a 4-week on‑prem POC in an air‑gapped DC starting week of 2024-04-22. They explicitly require: signed offline bundle + SBOM, a way to integrate with their HSM or PKCS#11 KMS, a documented offline cert rotation process, and clarity on upgrade cadence (security team is pushing for monthly patches which might be unrealistic). Also need an offline pricing/POC quote and a short runbook for installs. Any immediate blockers?

mike_se: We can support signed tarball bundles + SBOM. Two quick Qs: do they expect USB transfer only, or will a jumpbox (customer-controlled) be allowed to fetch bundles from us? Also need to confirm HSM mode: PKCS#11 vs external API. If PKCS#11, we ship a hooking agent; if external API, we need a network path from the jumpbox to their KMS. :eyes:

olivia_sales: Customer said "no outbound egress from the cluster" — jumpbox allowed but it cannot call external endpoints. They mentioned on‑prem Thales HSM with PKCS#11.

pj_fieldeng: OK — plan: we produce a signed bundle (GPG or X.509) + SBOM and a delta patch mechanism. We can support PKCS#11 integration via our agent that talks to the mounted HSM socket. For cert rotation offline, options: 1) BYO-CA certs (customer provides signed certs in the bundle), 2) rotation bundle tool that accepts new certs and hot-swaps locally. We usually recommend BYO-CA for air‑gapped customers. Example bundle manifest we include: 

```
version: "1.0"
components:
  - name: runtime
    image: runtime-v2.3.1.tar.gz
    sha256: abc123...def
  - name: sbom
    file: sbom-runtime-2.3.1.json
signature: runtime-v2.3.1.sig
```

We sign the manifest with our signing key and provide verification docs.

anya_security: From the security questionnaire POV we need to answer: how secrets are stored (envelope encryption using customer KMS/HSM), key rotation cadence, and attestations for bundle signing. For the monthly patch ask: we can support critical hotfix pushes as delta bundles, but default supported cadence is quarterly for nonsecurity-critical changes. We'll document SLA for emergency fixes. Also need to confirm accepted CAs for signing and whether they require FIPS 140-2 HSM proofs. :lock:

nate_ops: Operational notes: POC environment constraints: max disk 1.5TB, single public NIC disabled, SELinux enabled. We'll need the customer's install engineer to run pre-check script; we'll provide a small `preflight.sh` to validate kernel and cgroups. Telemetry: since egress blocked, we recommend the customer runs our collector locally and gives periodic bundle of logs to their Redwood SRE contact.

olivia_sales: Pricing question — can we offer a flat POC fee + temporary license? They prefer fixed cost. Anything standard for air-gapped POC?

mike_se: Standard we use: one-time NRE for packaging + signed bundle (estimate 2 engineer-days) plus a short-term POC license (30 days) at a discounted rate. If they want on‑site assist or faster turnaround, add SOW. I'll prepare a quote draft. :thumbsup:

pj_fieldeng: Timeline to produce validated signed bundle + SBOM + preflight: ~10 business days if we get HSM access details and a test manifest early. For delta patches we can produce a signed patch in 2-3 business days (hotfix flow). We also need sample certs for rotation testing.

olivia_sales: Customer asked about upgrade cadence in contract language — can we commit to "quarterly non-security updates" and "security hotfix within 72h of validation"?

anya_security: We can commit to quarterly for feature releases. For security hotfix SLA: 72h triage + coordinate with customer for offline transfer — operationally realistic. We'll require a security contact and an escalation path in the contract.

nate_ops: Blockers: we need a signed access matrix from the customer for HSM sockets, and confirmation on whether they accept USB delivery or require transfer via their jumpbox. Also confirm acceptance tests and who signs acceptance.

olivia_sales: I'll ask BigBank to confirm jumpbox vs USB and get the HSM contact. Mike, can you please draft the NRE + 30d license quote? PJ, please confirm the 10-day bundle lead if we hand off specs by next Tue.

mike_se: On it — will post quote in this thread by EOD tomorrow.

pj_fieldeng: Confirmed — 10 business days after spec + test certs. Will also include a short runbook and smoke-test checklist.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: INF-2567 — "sideload bundle + PKCS#11 integration for BigBank POC" (assignees: mike_se, pj_fieldeng). Link: https://redwood.internal/INF-2567

olivia_sales: Great — thanks everyone. I'll loop in the customer's HSM admin and legal for the SLA language. :raised_hands:
